# Harbor Finance (harborfintech.com)

> Harbor Finance is a premier Indian study-abroad financing and student advisory platform headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Harbor Finance assists Indian students in securing secured and unsecured education loans, international student forex cards, tuition remittances, and comprehensive study-abroad financial guidance.

## Core Services
- **Education Loans for Study Abroad**: Compare and secure education loans from 20+ partner banks and NBFCs (including SBI, HDFC Credila, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Avanse, InCred, Auxilo, and Prodigy Finance). 
- **End-to-End Advisory**: Profile evaluation, university eligibility checks, collateral verification, documentation assistance, and sanction within an average of 48 hours.
- **Harbor Forex**: Zero-forex-markup student cards, live interbank exchange rates, guaranteed A2 remittances, university tuition fee transfers, and GIC / blocked account funding.
- **Free Student Advisory**: 100% free guidance for students — no hidden fees or advisory charges.

## Popular Study Destinations Covered
- **United States (USA)**: Fall & Spring intakes, STEM OPT funding, co-signer and non-cosigner options.
- **United Kingdom (UK)**: CAS letter proof of funds, Graduate Route visa compliance.
- **Canada**: SDS-compliant GIC funding, PGWP work permit pathways.
- **Australia**: Subclass 500 visa financial requirements, genuine student documentation.
- **Germany**: Blocked accounts and public/private university financing.
- **Ireland, France, Singapore, New Zealand**: Dedicated destination guides and expense breakdowns.
